G1_unambiguity.justification: The package definitions make it unambiguous that a pair covers all four metrics exactly when its two buoys use different packages.

G2_completeness.justification: The statement specifies the package assignments, metric coverage, pair constraints, input bounds and format, output format, and acceptance of any valid assignment.

G3_faithfulness.justification: Because each package omits a different metric, requiring every pair to cover all four metrics is exactly equivalent to requiring conflicting workers to receive different labels, with the same bounds and outputs.

G4_naturalness.justification: The rewritten scenario is coherent and readable, though the elaborate sensor narrative is somewhat contrived for a three-coloring problem.
